backup.production_rule: KPI accuracy (docs/s91/KPI-AUDIT.md). Part 1, the numbers: admin_stays_v1 stops counting the DIRECT: mirror reservation of every confirmed direct stay (F1: July RevPAR 1,238.69, October 853.96, ALOS and cancellation rate follow), sums split Airbnb payout rows instead of taking the larger (F2: four stays were short by 180.00, 1,700.00, 6,291.10, 8,827.00) and dates a booking from created_at when the export has no booking date (F7). get_finance_summary (Telegram /summary) leaves Airbnb mirror and estimate rows out of income, categories and the pending count and nets drawings (F3: September income 26,946.73, October 15,454.28, August net 25,188.04; new key drawings). get_missed_cleanings counts from the Manila date (F6). inventory_purchases.units_per_purchase becomes numeric(10,4) and record_inventory_receipt_v1 drops its ::integer cast (F10). Part 2, the mechanism: hospitality_metrics_core_v1 (the live metrics body without its two auth lines; get_hospitality_metrics_v1 calls it, same signature and grants), kpi_recompute_v1 (a second count from the raw tables), kpi_reconcile_v1 and kpi_reconcile_window_v1 (compare, current Manila month and three before). run_system_verifier_v1 appends V19 findings in the daily scope; apply_verifier_run_v1 lists V19 in the daily checks only; health_checks_core_v1 gains the finance row kpi_reconciled; health_check_problem_v1 gets its sentence. The four new functions are internal (no role can execute them). get_finance_summary's pending count also leaves out pending_review airbnb_email rows (the Telegram /summary pending count drops by those). The cleaner fee comparison counts category 'cleaning' only (a 40.00 supplies expense through the cleaner-fee flow has no session by design). A revenue defect raises one red per month (ADR and RevPAR are muted). Expected first daily run after the apply: yellow hygiene confirmed_estimates_dead n=3 until supabase/sql/2026-10-16-s91-kpi-data-fixes.sql has run; no red.
backup.notes: Apply order: the two migrations (one release), THEN the data-fix file (Lloyd's block, run-sql-on-host.sh), THEN the four waves functions (all verify_jwt false): system-verifier (cards.ts case V19, audience finance), daily-digest (health-labels.ts, report.ts F9), airbnb-email-sync (F4 guard), finance-watch (F8, F9). Until system-verifier has the V19 card, a V19 finding would be rendered by the default card; deploy the SQL and that function in the same window. ALTER COLUMN TYPE (integer to numeric) is why this is not an expand release; it is a widening, so compatibility.verified stays false only until the rehearsal has run green on this commit.
